title: Demolished retaining wall built over a boundary: third notice to fix (Hillcrest, Hamilton)
jurisdiction: New Zealand (MBIE, Building Act 2004): comparative test only; not an Alberta case; no Alberta applicability asserted
document_type: MBIE determination under Building Act 2004 s188 (regulator decision on an individual matter); not an applicant's alternative-solution file

facts.text: A neighbour built a retaining wall over the boundary and later demolished it, leaving an unretained cut; the owners' engineers' report (14 November 2019) includes a photograph of the cut.
Authority issued three notices to fix; this determination concerns the third notice to the owners.
Owners are not specified persons under s163 (not owners for the purposes of the third notice and did not carry out or supervise the work); s164 is not satisfied.
Commentary: remedies in the first notice left the owners with an unretained slope.
Decision: authority incorrect to issue the third notice (30 November 2022).
